about: Folder-sync failures found so far, as exact step sequences. scripts/check_folder_model.py (desktop) and web/scripts/check-folder-model.mjs (browser) run every case on every check, before their random runs: a failure once found stays exercised. Add one for each new failure (from those checks, the end-to-end check or a report), in the steps below, with what it caught. Steps: ["save", who, op, at] an editor saves its part of main.tex on A or B (op 0 insert, 1 delete, 2 change a line; at: where); ["type", op, at] typing into A's project; ["collab", op, at] the collaborator C types; ["collab_crlf", op, at] C's older app adds a line with Windows line endings; ["deliver", src, dst] changes from one of A, B, C to another; ["sync", who] a sync round on A or B (browser: 3 s pass); ["time", ms] time passes (browser only); ["refuse", who, true|false] writes to that folder refused or allowed again; ["older", who, pick] an older copy the sync wrote comes back; ["toggle", who] the app (page) quits, or starts again.

cases.name: a refused write, then the file saved
cases.found: 0.4.26: by hand while chasing a CI timeout. The collaborator's edit was noted as written before the write; the save then undid it.

cases.name: a change not yet written, the app closed, the file saved, the app started
cases.found: 0.4.27: the model checks. The last-synced text was only in memory, so the save replaced the project's text.

cases.name: an undo saved in the editor
cases.found: 0.4.27: the model checks. Going back to an earlier version was taken for a stale copy and reverted.

cases.name: an older copy comes back to a Windows file
cases.found: 0.4.27: the model checks. Detecting the stale copy dropped the file's record, and with it its line endings.

cases.name: changes arrive just after a save the sync hasn't read
cases.found: 0.4.27: the browser model. The browser wrote the collaborators' changes over the save 300 ms later.

cases.name: Windows line endings from a collaborator's older app
cases.found: 0.4.28: the sync-only check on Windows (browser pasting \r\n). The desktop app kept \r in the project; only the web app took them out.

cases.name: a refused write, then nothing else changes
cases.found: 0.4.28: written for the browser, whose 2 s poll only read the folder: a refused write waited for the next change to be tried again.
